name: vercel
description: Publishes the site's static export to Vercel with the workspace's own saved token. Ships the host code itself (Tovu loads it only because Tovu shipped it) and the know-how an agent needs: where to get a token, the optional team, Deployment Protection, and what each failure means in plain words.
author: Tovu

tovu.summary: Puts your website online on Vercel. The assistant shows you a preview first.
